rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when a light is directed onto something.

example.english: I’ll illuminate the doorway with a flashlight while I wait for you to come back.
example.traditional: 我用電筒照住門口，等你返嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 tung2 ziu3 zyu6 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5 faan1 lai4

rows.note: Use this when explaining a point or making its meaning clear.

example.english: Can you illuminate the issue a bit more clearly?
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cing1 co2 di1

rows.note: Use this when something emits light or visibly glows.

example.english: This lamp will illuminate as soon as it is switched on.
example.jyutping: ni1 zaan2 dang1 jat1 hoi1 zau6 faat3 gwong1

rows.note: Use this when a lamp or indicator light comes on, rather than simply describing its glow.

example.english: The indicator light starts to illuminate as soon as you plug it in.
example.traditional: 個指示燈一插電就著燈。
example.jyutping: go3 zi2 si6 dang1 jat1 caap3 din6 zau6 zoek6 dang1
